planner_decision: Board evidence (b10 r1 v3, captures_final) shows the A+ core is not deadlocked: a1_busy=1 is frame_active, a1_in_ready=1 while fstate=F_WAIT and rd_state=R_RW with rd_armed=1. The reader issued 1177 AR handshakes, received 1176 R beats (raw_rd_idx/read_words frozen at 1176, identical in b9 and b10), i.e. one DDR read response is lost. The 'busy core not accepting input' is read starvation. Fix scope is the DDR read-response path plus a bounded liveness watchdog, not the reader FSM.
